shellCommands.command: git diff package.json && cat package.json && find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -path ./.git -prune -o -type f -print | head -50 && ls node_modules/next/dist/docs/
for f in next.config.ts app/*.tsx tsconfig.json; do echo "=== $f"; cat $f; done; grep -ril "partial pre\|cacheComponents\|ppr" node_modules/next/dist/docs/ | head -30
ls node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/*/ ; grep -ril "static shell" node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app | head

f=$(ls .next/server/app/index.html 2>/dev/null || find .next/server/app -name 'index*.html' | head -1); echo $f; grep -o '<main>.*</main>' $f | sed 's/<!--[^>]*-->//g' | head -c 1500; echo; git checkout -q tsconfig.json; git status --short
